references.text: David expresses trust that God will give him the right words when facing enemies, which reflects the trust disciples are encouraged to have when they face persecution.
Ezekiel is told by God that he will be given the words to say, which resembles the promise Jesus gives his disciples.
Peter is filled with the Holy Spirit and speaks to the people, illustrating the fulfillment of Jesus' promise that disciples will be given what they are to say.
Stephen, filled with wisdom and the Spirit, speaks in a way that his opponents cannot resist, showing how God's Spirit equips believers to defend the gospel.
